final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only ERROR and CRITICAL levels (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC with the required format. Extracted service, level (uppercased), message, last traceback line or null, and repeat counts from following repeat lines. Summed repeat counts per service. Wrote the structured data to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
checks.detail: RULE: the top-level object has "schema_version": 2 and "generated_by": "log-triage".
